verdict.rationale: Digits' Agentic Close continuously books activity, starts reconciliation before month-end, runs quality control, and surfaces exceptions with context. Its AI bookkeeping adds 24/7 transaction flagging and smart reviews, and ingestion deduplicates entries automatically. A read-only MCP server and webhooks also let external agents monitor and analyze the live ledger. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of spend-anomaly detection (as opposed to generic flagging and exceptions), duplicate detection on already-booked transactions rather than ingestion-time dedup, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
